obligations.summary: Providers of general-purpose AI models are subject to the procedural rights set out in Article 18 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 applied mutatis mutandis, without prejudice to more specific procedural rights provided for in the AI Act.
exceptions: More specific procedural rights provided elsewhere in the AI Act take precedence over Article 18 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 where applicable.
